lines: He said his garden would never die... by the next morning, it was gone.
There was one sentence he forgot to say... a sentence that could have saved everything. Stay till the end.
Allah gave a man two gardens of grapevines, bordered with palm trees.
One day he walked into his garden, proud of all he had, and said:
His friend reminded him of that one sentence... but he did not listen.
That night... his fruit was destroyed.
The sentence he forgot: Masha'Allah, la quwwata illa billah. What Allah wills... there is no power except with Allah.
Everything you have is from Allah. Look at one blessing today... and say this sentence.
